title: Indonesia NZE Transition and Provincial RUED Dashboard

national_goal.description: Net zero emissions by 2060 or earlier is the national long-term goal; ESDM 2026 describes sector transition aspirations across 2050–2060, not a verified binding nationwide NZE 2050 deadline.

ken.notes: New KEN 2025 range is from ESDM Ditjen EBTKE 2025 performance report. Old RUEN Perpres 22/2017 target of 23% EBT by 2025 is a historical policy benchmark, not the sole current standard.

rued.status: Province-specific implementation; no verified single national completion score
rued.governance: RUED-P provincial energy plans; progress should track adopted regional regulation, regional primary energy mix, generation commissioning, yearly targets and budget execution.
rued.coverage: DEN 2025 annual report describes receiving 2024 provincial mix reporting and follow-up evaluation; this is not an independently verified score of nationwide RUED attainment.
rued.case_law: East Java Provincial Regulation No. 3 of 2024 (amending No. 6 of 2019)
rued.notes: A regional RUED target must be compared with data for the same province and year, not with the national EBT mix. No provincial realization is filled without its official release.

ruplt.status: Planned RUPTL additions; not completed construction
ruplt.notes: Renewables, storage and fossil are separately accounted. The 76% headline includes storage; it is not 76% renewable generation share.

emissions.scope: KLHK national GHG inventory reproduced by BPS; energy sector and all-sector total in million tonnes CO2-equivalent (MtCO2e). All-sector series includes forestry/land use and peat fires. Does not equal fossil CO2 only or verified mitigation savings.
emissions.disclaimer: Inventory 2024–2026 figures are not asserted here. BPS statistical table updated 2 February 2026; last time-series observation 2023.

mitigation.scope: ESDM reported achieved sector emissions reductions / avoided emissions, not emitted tonnes. Do not plot on the same emissions axis as BPS inventory; not interchangeable with absolute GHG emissions.

monitoring_framework.label: Power-system transition
monitoring_framework.question: Which renewables/storage capacity was commissioned, connected, and dispatched rather than merely announced?

monitoring_framework.label: Fiscal and technology
monitoring_framework.question: Do investment, grid expansion, and renewable integration happen fast enough to displace fossil generation?

monitoring_framework.label: Regional RUED execution
monitoring_framework.question: Do provincial realizations and local budgets match each RUED regulation, without borrowing national totals?

monitoring_framework.label: Carbon consistency
monitoring_framework.question: Are absolute emissions, mitigation claims and emissions intensity moving as expected, with transparent baselines?
